name.description: The full name of the recipient.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the recipient.

accountNumber.description: The recipient bank account number or IBAN.

sortCode.description: The UK sort code, required for Faster Payments.

iban.description: The IBAN, required for SEPA transfers.

bic.description: The BIC/SWIFT code for the recipient bank.

email.description: The recipient email, required for Interac transfers.

phoneNumber.description: The recipient phone number, required for Mobile Money.
